the_hole_this_closes.what_the_census_did: priced 3,230 governance records by the weight their own status can bear
the_hole_this_closes.what_it_never_did: verify a single one of them. The record said PROVEN and the census believed it.
the_hole_this_closes.why_that_matters: 'how valuable it is' depends on whether the thing is true. A census that never checks is a well-organised assumption.
the_hole_this_closes.this_round: audited the PROVEN tier against the artefacts each record itself cites, by existing on disk and by executing

the_audit.green_rate_basis: 134 of 143 executable-and-non-empty cited tests; the 4 collection errors and 9 empty files are excluded from both numerator and denominator rather than being counted as passes or failures

the_9_cited_tests_that_execute_nothing.meaning: 0 passed, 0 failed -- the file exists, is cited as evidence, and runs no assertions
the_9_cited_tests_that_execute_nothing.why_this_is_not_called_RED: calling it red would overstate breakage; calling it green would overstate coverage. A cited evidence file with no assertions is a documentation defect, not a failure, and it needs its own category.

the_audit_failed_first_and_the_failure_w.why_that_was_obviously_wrong: a tree cannot have 160 uniformly failing evidence files and still be a tree that runs 89 tests green in this session
the_audit_failed_first_and_the_failure_w.the_cause: pytest was not installed in the sandbox. Every subprocess returned 'No module named pytest', my parser saw 0 passed and 0 failed, and classified it as RED. One hundred and sixty false accusations of the tree, produced by my own environment.
the_audit_failed_first_and_the_failure_w.the_fix: installed pytest, re-ran, and got 134 green / 9 empty / 13 red / 4 collection errors
the_audit_failed_first_and_the_failure_w.why_this_is_recorded: this is the third time this session that a harness gap produced a wrong verdict about the tree. The pattern is consistent: when a measurement comes back uniformly damning, suspect the instrument before the subject.

what_the_audit_actually_establishes.proven_and_checkable: 348 of 681 PROVEN records cite a concrete artefact; 93.8% of the cited tests that execute anything run green
what_the_audit_actually_establishes.proven_but_deductive: 333 of 681 PROVEN records (48.9%) cite no runnable artefact. They assert a deduction or a reconciliation. They may well be correct, but this audit did NOT check them and says so.
what_the_audit_actually_establishes.the_two_missing_modules: 2 of 589 distinct cited modules do not exist on disk. That is a concrete, small, fixable defect: either the module was renamed or the record cites something that was never built.
what_the_audit_actually_establishes.the_13_failing_tests: 13 cited evidence files have real failures. Each one is a PROVEN record whose supporting test does not currently pass. That is the single most actionable finding of this round.

what_this_still_does_NOT_prove: that a green test measures the sentence the record asserts -- a passing test can test the wrong thing, and nothing here detects that
that a module which exists implements what the citing record says it implements
anything at all about the 333 deduction-only PROVEN records
anything about the 2,549 non-PROVEN records, which were never in scope for this audit

the_honest_scorecard_after_this_round.claims_audited_by_execution: 160 cited test files, of which 134 green, 13 red, 9 empty, 4 uncollectable
the_honest_scorecard_after_this_round.fraction_of_the_whole_governance_populat: 160 test files against 3,230 records -- a small slice, stated plainly

the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.action: fix or reclassify the 13 PROVEN records whose cited test fails
the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.why: these are the only records in the tree currently known to cite evidence that does not pass. It is a small, concrete, finishable list.

the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.action: delete or repair the 2 cited modules that do not exist
the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.why: a claim citing a missing file is the cheapest possible defect to find and the most damaging to leave

the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.action: give the 9 EMPTY cited tests real assertions, or stop citing them as evidence
the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.why: an evidence file that asserts nothing is worse than no citation because it looks like support

the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.action: extend the audit past the PROVEN tier to ACTIVE and REFUSED
the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.why: REFUSED records are the tree's memory of what failed; if a refusal is wrong it misdirects future work permanently

the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.action: make the audit a scheduled test with a floor, so a green rate cannot silently decay
the_smartest_next_moves__from_the_audit.why: 93.8% is a number worth defending, and undefended numbers decay
